messages:
sara: Following up on the postmortem for the analytics/observability incidents. Ive pulled the action items into one thread so we can track owners, dates, and blockers. Please ack and add any changes.

sara: TL;DR actions (owner -> ETA -> ticket):
- T1 tracing drop root cause and exporter hardening -> @ajay -> 2025-05-07 -> INF-4501
- T2 aggregation reduce-stage null-key handling -> @maria -> 2025-04-30 -> INF-4510
- T3 ETL delayed partitions backfill + alert revamp -> @tim -> 2025-05-12 -> DATA-790
- T4 golden-trace smoke + CI gate -> @lex -> 2025-05-03 -> ADD-999
- T5 cross-team pre-deploy checklist for high-cardinality jobs -> @oliver -> 2025-05-20 -> OPS-212

ajay: acked. INF-4501: Im instrumenting exporter queue metrics and adding a per-batch seq id. I hit one odd case where producer retries piled up during a broker rebalance. Will add circuit-breaker and change retry backoff. Plan: small canary on svc-x next Tue.

maria: acked. INF-4510: found mapper output that serializes "null" as empty-string which reduces to wrong buckets. Patch submitted. test harness includes 500k keys to simulate boundary. Link to draft: https://git.redwood.ai/r/analytics/agg/changes/4510

tim: ack. DATA-790: creating a backfill job that runs in low-cost zone with checkpointed progress. Also proposing new alert: partition_lag_seconds > 1800 for 15m to go P1. Draft alert rule below:
```
alert: PartitionLagP1
expr: max_over_time(partition_lag_seconds[15m]) > 1800
labels:
  severity: page
annotations:
  summary: "Partition lag >30m for {{ $labels.partition }}"
```
Will need infra quota bump; filing DATA-790-1 for that.

lex: will own golden-trace smoke. proposal: 1000 sample spans per service, daily run, mismatch threshold 3%. If mismatch>3% fail CI and create a ticket in INF-ops. Will post schema for golden set by EOD.

oliver: will draft pre-deploy checklist focusing on high-cardinality ingestion, mapper/reducer shard boundaries, and broker capacity tests. Suggest adding a step to run lightweight synthetic traffic at 1.5x expected QPS.

srebot: Reminder: Postmortem INC-2025-03-12 accepted. Owners must update their ticket status within 72h or a follow-up ping will be sent.

devops-bot: Deploy-canary: svc-x exporter canary scheduled for 2025-04-24 02:00Z. Monitor: exporter_queue_depth, exporter_retries, kafka_broker_cpu.

sara: A few coordination notes: 
- Please put short test plans in the ticket (one-line is fine).
- If you need infra/quota, add a subtask with estimated hours.
- I scheduled a 20min sync Thursday to unblock owners only, drop if all tasks have green ETAs.

ajay: question: for seq-id changes, do we want to persist ids into traces topic or only local metadata? persisting helps post-incident forensics but increases payload ~8 bytes per batch. leaning persist.

maria: persist, please. makes root-cause easier.

lex: quick thought on alerts: set alert to warn at 10m lag and page at 30m. reduces noisy P1s.

tim: +1 for 10m warning. will add both thresholds.

sara: great. final ask: after you ack, update the ticket with ETA + test plan by EOD tomorrow. Ill post a tracker doc with links and mark blocked items. Thanks all. :white_check_mark:
